verdict.rationale: Carta documents first-party Claude MCP plugins that let users query cap tables, SAFEs, grants, 409A valuations and fund data, and generate tear sheets, budgets, financial statements and PDFs, "all with natural language." However, this works only through an external LLM client (Claude), and the documented scope is mostly querying and reporting rather than operating the product broadly. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language interface, evidence of natural-language write/transactional actions (e.g., issuing grants, editing records), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
